cohort_selection_reason: Independent GPL570 NSCLC cohort with explicit histology; selected before outcome analysis because it matches the locked LUAD/LUSC target and GSE37745 platform.

eligibility.exclude: All other histology labels, including adenosquamous and large-cell carcinoma.
eligibility.missing_data: No outcome-based filtering or feature substitution is permitted.

locked_model.pipeline: Within-sample percentile-rank transform, fold-local feature selection, balanced logistic regression
locked_model.input_feature_mapping: Same outcome-blind GPL570 probe mapping used for GSE37745

threshold_design.tie_break: threshold closest to 0.5, then lower threshold
threshold_design.final_cohort: GSE50081 is not used for feature, parameter, or threshold selection
